description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeOnLeaveApiTest' for testing the 'EmployeeOnLeaveAPI' REST API related to Employee Leave data in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes setup for integrations, mock configurations, and test methods for API endpoints, particularly focusing on the 'getAll' method. Additional tests confirm that some methods are not implemented.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveApiTest
classes.description: JUnit test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, designed to validate the API functions of EmployeeOnLeaveAPI, including fetching all employee leave entries and handling unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Test method that populates fixtures, sets up mock services, registers dependencies, and verifies the 'getAll' API functionality with various test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Data provider supplying a set of parameterized test cases from a YAML configuration for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.name: configEnablingPreHook
methods.description: Configures a specific system setting related to displaying employee leaves by retrieving and updating the corresponding database entity.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that invoking the 'create' method on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' correctly throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'delete' on the API raises a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' raises a 'not implemented' exception.
